label: V1 invalid-checksum revision
verification: The VANOS runtime behavior was proven on-car, but the released descriptor omitted the enforced MS41.0 program-checksum recomputation. Retained byte-for-byte for exact installed-image detection and safe removal.
title: VANOS minimum RPM
user_description: Legacy MS41.0 V1 omitted the required program-checksum update. Upgrade to V3 to restore the factory default and retain the configured RPM.
description: VANOSRT1 at file 0x17008 identifies this exact revision for upgrade and removal. V1 treated the reserved default as 8,160 RPM and its released descriptor omitted the enforced program checksum. Removal recomputes the checksum.
